# Process: Pot Cycle
**Process ID:** P-100  
**Version:** 1.3 (Approved)  
**Owner:** Lead Operator  
**Approver:** Site B Plant Manager  

> SYNTHETIC FIXTURE for DocBrain tests. Site B is fictional; nothing here describes a real plant.

## 1. Purpose
Run one batch of the synthetic pot cycle on Kiln K-7 and Kiln K-8.

## 2. Roles & Responsibilities
| Role | Responsibility |
|------|----------------|
| Lead Operator | Authorises the batch, the lid opening, and the transfer. |

## 3. Operating Limits
| Parameter | Limit | Evidence |
|-----------|-------|----------|
| Lid opening temperature | < 45 °C | Synthetic manufacturer sheet SB-MS-03 |
| Cycle duration | 16 h | Synthetic recipe SB-R-02 |

## 4. Steps
1. Confirm Kilns K-7 and K-8 are below the lid opening temperature.
2. Lead Operator authorises the batch and starts the cycle.
